integrity: Derived analytic inequality and equality cases; finite verification is supplemental. Prior literature is acknowledged; priority is not independently certified.
limitations: Two exact Gaussian oscillator modes with integer frequency ratio \(m\ge2\), iid state-independent integration times, full momentum refresh, synchronous expected squared Euclidean discrepancy. Not a wall-clock, optimal-Wasserstein-coupling, nonlinear, or inhomogeneous-schedule guarantee.
title: Sharp parity frontier for iid integration times in two-mode ideal Gaussian HMC
